about: DigiTriad 0.2 for Digitone OS 1.43 and 1.44: the author's released .elemod files, pinned unchanged.

mods.title: DigiTriad
mods.summary: A pitch shifter for the audio inputs: three voices in a key and scale (or chromatic), each through its own delay, four delay modes, rhythms and MIDI CCs. With fxkit (0.2): a mixer, two LFOs on the stock LFO page aimed at its controls, p-locks kept in the pattern, and the MIDI tracks editable while it plays. The synths are silent while it is the active effect.
mods.description: A three-voice rhythmic pitch shifter for the Digitone mk1's audio inputs: three voices from -2 to +2 octaves, chromatic or in a key and scale (Major, Minor, Melodic Minor, Harmonic Minor, Double Harmonic, Lydian and Minor Pentatonic) from the note a pitch detector hears, with microtune, glide and pitch correction, each behind its own time division of a delay in time with the Digitone's tempo, in four delay modes (pitch feedback, series, dual with cross feedback, dual), rhythm patterns, half speed, swell, freeze, and MIDI CCs. DIGITRIAD in core-dn1's Mod Menu (hold a track key) makes it the active effect and opens its page; while it is active it owns the audio engine (the synths are muted) and processes the inputs, through fxkit's MIXER (AMP), with two LFOs aimed at its controls (LFO) and p-locks on the pattern's steps (RECORD: hold a trig, turn a control). MIDI leaves the page to edit the MIDI tracks while it plays; NO turns it off. Needs fxkit (core-dn1 4.1).
mods.author: irpina
mods.on_unit: 0.2 tested on a Digitone mk1 by its author (Oct 2026), built before the effects' rename, which changed only names; still a beta. Also checked in digikit's emulator on OS 1.43 and 1.44. Not yet run on a Digitone Keys.
